correctness.rationale: The codimension-one and codimension-two Jacobian formulas show that an invertible linear map multiplies every facet mass and every ridge conductance by the common factor \(|\det A|\), so the generalized Rayleigh quotient is affine invariant. Every origin-symmetric parallelotope therefore reduces to a box. On a box, each signed facet has mass \(M=2^{n-1}V\), each ridge joining distinct coordinate directions has conductance \(C=2^{n-2}V\), and an even function is determined by \(n\) values \(x_i\). Thus the numerator is \(4C\sum_{i<j}(x_i-x_j)^2\), the variance is \(2M\sum_i(x_i-\bar x)^2\), and \(4C=2M\). The complete-graph identity supplies the factor \(n\). Fresh exact replay confirmed the algebra in dimensions 2 through 8.

final_claim: For every full-dimensional origin-symmetric parallelotope in \(\mathbb R^n\), \(n\ge2\), the Hu--Ivaki even facet-network Dirichlet form satisfies \(L_P(f,f)=n\sum_i m_i(f_i-\bar f)^2\) for every even facet function; hence the complete even generalized spectrum is zero once and \(n\) with multiplicity \(n-1\).
